releaseRule: The application may be marked FINAL_APP_READY only when the Mass subsystem remains certified, all app-level blockers are closed, the modular shell owns visible six-destination navigation, and the required cross-domain phone journey passes against actual index.html.
requiredPhoneJourney: cold launch -> Home -> Calendar -> Mass selection -> native LIVE -> leave/resume -> PRAY -> Home -> Settings

findings.detail: R17 native Mass is a certified subsystem and is not an app-convergence blocker.
The complete certified special-structure scope has actual-index phone-Chromium evidence.
The Prayer Book aria-hidden/focused-descendant regression is explicitly exercised without Chromium blocked-aria-hidden warnings.
AO_APP_SHELL_V1 remains passive; historical global navigation still owns the visible shell.
The full cold-launch Home/Calendar/Mass/leave-resume/PRAY/Home/Settings journey is not yet automated end to end.
The embedded v43.33 emergency runtime remains a cleanup debt until required live-session locks are owned by final modular shell/settings code.
Production index.html is documented as containing a duplicated Mass browser-entry include; it must be removed and regression-locked.
Home, Calendar, PRAY, Learn and Settings still depend on monolith donor owners rather than final modular visible owners.
App-level certification still needs explicit fresh-state, interrupted-Mass, reload/resume and cross-module state-contamination coverage.
